g.text: The judge, checked by hand: about 7 in 10 "lost" calls are right

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Precision = share of the judge's "lost" calls that Jacob's hand label also called lost. 95% Wilson intervals. Recall was not measured. Offline audit: the definition of "lost" was settled

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: after seeing the labels (as first scored, 8/13), on cards drawn from the judge's dropped calls only. Sonnet, a bigger model from the same family, had similar observed precision on these
